title: Minimize Rounding Error to Meet Target
description: Minimize the sum of absolute rounding errors given prices as strings and a target sum.
pseudocode:
1. floors = prices.map(p => floor(p))
2. sumFloors = sum(floors)
3. diff = target - sumFloors
4. errors = prices.map(p => p - floor(p))
5. sort errors descending
6. take diff smallest errors as ceil, rest as floor
7. return sum of rounding errors

steps.note: Since diff is 2, round both up to satisfy target 3
